top_signals.title: Lagarde Warns Europe is Too Hesitant Responding to Crises
top_signals.summary: Outgoing ECB President Christine Lagarde in her final speech to the European Banking Congress urges policymakers to tackle risks before they materialize. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump’s Ukraine Energy Truce Unravels as Russian Missiles Hit Kyiv
top_signals.summary: Politics, Geopolitics & Conflict Trump’s October “energy truce” between Russia and Ukraine in October is over, and Vladimir Putin has taken a new one off the table. After meeting Trump and Xi at the APEC summit on Thursday, Putin said Russia would not negotiate after Ukraine’s strikes on the Crimean Bridge. Russia hit Kyiv with ballistic missiles and drones Friday morning, killing at least three people, damaging three bridges and a critical infrastructure facility, and forcing power cuts in the capital and three western…

top_signals.title: Iraq's Oil Crackdown Sparks New Showdown With Kurdistan
top_signals.summary: Iraq’s federal government is using its oil-smuggling case against the pro-Iranian militia Kata’ib Hezbollah south of Baghdad to force the Kurdistan Regional Government in the north to hand over more oil and open its fields to federal inspectors. South of Baghdad, the Iraqi PM has ordered federal forces to take over a pipeline at Jurf al-Sakhar (Babil province) that the pro-Iranian militia has been illegally tapping into since at least 2021. top_signals.title: Iran Steps Up Hormuz Tanker Attacks as Oil Prices Slide
top_signals.summary: Iran has intensified attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz in recent weeks, just as crude oil flows from the Persian Gulf recover and oil prices fall amid expectations of oversupply within months. The number of attacks soared in October to the highest level since the Iran war began at the end of February, and has continued at nearly daily occurrences so far in November, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. Meanwhile, crude oil volumes flowing from the Strait of Hormuz have declined in recent days, although it’s unclear if this is…

top_signals.title: WTI Crude Sinks More Than 5% as Global Oil Glut Fears Grow
top_signals.summary: The oil market spent the week weighing an increase in global supply against the risk of further disruptions in the Middle East. More crude is reaching buyers from the region, while U.S. inventories are building. Attacks on tankers and energy infrastructure remain a threat, but they have not been enough to stop the decline in prices. For now, the supply story appears to be winning. January West Texas Intermediate crude oil futures are down more than 5% for the week. The decline suggests traders are putting more weight on the barrels reaching the…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.summary: BlackRock's IBIT made up nearly all of Thursday's outflows, despite Morgan Stanley's MSBT attracting $49.6 million.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
